analyses.groupDescription: Cox Regression Analysis of Overall Survival: C-reactive protein (CRP) \> 13 μg/ml; Statistical analysis plan (SAP) specified subgroup analysis

primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: Overall survival was measured as the length of time (in days) between the randomization date and the date of death.

groups.description: Subjects received ruxolitinib 15 mg BID plus capecitabine at a starting dose of 2000 mg/m\^2 (1000 mg/m\^2 twice a day \[BID\]).
groups.title: Ruxolitinib

groups.description: Matching placebo tablets were administered as oral doses in the same manner as active drug during the randomized portion of the study. Capecitabine starting dose - 2000 mg/m\^2 (1000 mg/m\^2 twice a day \[BID\]).
groups.title: Placebo

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: The intent-to-treat (ITT) population included subjects randomized in Part 2 of the study.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.timeFrame: Primary analysis includes study data from the start of the study (first dose for that subject) until the death of the subject (up to 8 months).
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Overall Survival
